properties.title: Japanese auto parts exec gets jail for price fixing
properties.summary:
Makoto Horie, formerly senior vice president of sales at the US arm of Toyoda Gosei, agreed to plead guilty to one felony charge of price fixing and bid rigging in sales of automotive hoses to Toyota Motor Corp's U.S. subsidiaries and suppliers. Toyoda Gosei has been fined $26 million in two cases, on involving automotive hoses and another over price fixing for airbags and steering wheels.
